name: Net Report V 04
definition: The Net Report message is sent to a participant by a central system to provide details of the bi-lateral payment obligations, calculated by the central system per currency.

NetReportData.name: Net Report Data
NetReportData.definition: Specifies the meta data associated with the net report.

NetServiceParticipantIdentification.name: Net Service Participant Identification
NetServiceParticipantIdentification.definition: Describes the participant receiving the net report.

NetServiceCounterpartyIdentification.name: Net Service Counterparty Identification
NetServiceCounterpartyIdentification.definition: Describes the counterparty participant involved in (all of) the obligations of the report.

NetObligation.name: Net Obligation
NetObligation.definition: Provides the amount, direct parties or netting groups involved in the obligation.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

CounterpartyIdentificationRule.definition: NetServiceCounterpartyIdentification must only be used at this level if all of the underlying obligations are with a single counterparty.
